_provenance.title: DRT production-recipe scorecard
_provenance.selection: The poster shows six public-safe production recipes from the complete source matrix. DINOv3 selects the source's uncapped production recipe but is printed without a configuration suffix because the other task cells also belong to that full recipe. To keep excluded recipes entirely out of the public view, displayed ranks are recomputed only within the six shown recipes and labelled that way.
_provenance.excluded_arms: SONAR2-PE and V-JEPA 2.1 are excluded because they are not public. DINO-RADIO, including every variant, is excluded by author decision. Additional DINOv3 and internal-copy scheduling variants are omitted to keep one production recipe per displayed family.
_provenance.rank_rule: Displayed rank 1 is best among the six shown recipes; higher values are better except for Aria false-merge rate, where lower is better. The source's ranks among all 13 recipes are retained as non-rendered provenance only.
_provenance.uncertainty: The source scorecard reports point estimates and ranks without paired intervals. Poster ranks are descriptive and do not assert statistically established wins.
_provenance.note_alignment: paper/note2.md's Full Matrix agrees with all selected source values after six-decimal rounding.
_provenance.soccernet_qualification: Later separately authorized single-vector cosine lane; reconstructed-plan result whose historical plan hash was not reproduced.
_provenance.protocol_boundary: This scorecard is not the controlled frozen-matrix evaluation. Its HDD lane uses global-pair AP, VCDB uses matched random negatives, SoccerNet uses one normalized clip vector with cosine similarity, and Aria uses false merges at a transferred per-recipe threshold. Never attach the controlled matrix's chance floors, intervals, or order-sensitivity results to these cells.

datasets.label: Internal synthetic copies
datasets.protocol: Duration-balanced controlled edits; one whole-video vector per recipe.

datasets.label: VCDB
datasets.protocol: 527 videos; 5,585 positives plus 5,585 seed-42 matched random negatives.

datasets.label: SoccerNet-v2
datasets.protocol: One normalized clip vector with cosine similarity; 6,376 same-half headline queries plus 28 cross-half queries (6,404 total).

datasets.label: Honda HDD
datasets.protocol: 1,687 segments; 97,731 scored pairs, including 43,673 positives; chance floor 0.446869.

datasets.label: Project Aria
datasets.protocol: 78,324 confirmed-negative pairs; transferred per-recipe synthetic-copy P≥99% threshold; lower is better.
